narrative.overview:
StandBy 6s translates the calm physical clarity of a Braun desktop chronometer and Apple StandBy utility into a dedicated always-on landscape display for an iPhone 6s (`667×375` baseline). Every decision serves effortless glanceability from 1–3 meters away in daylight or a pitch-black bedroom, pairing oversized tabular numerals on flat matte charcoal surfaces with disciplined 1px structural hairlines and zero decorative clutter.

Thermal and visual restraint are inseparable here. The surface rejects glassmorphism, neon glows, drop shadows, gradients, 3D skeuomorphic bevels, and continuous 60fps animation loops so the hardware stays cool on 24/7 charging power while remaining visually serene. When darkness falls, the entire token layer pivots cleanly into narrow-spectrum Night Red mode—eliminating cool wavelengths without sacrificing WCAG AA legibility.
keyCharacteristics: Flat matte dark surface layering separated by crisp 1px hairlines rather than drop shadows or blur
Oversized tabular numerals in self-hosted Be Vietnam Pro engineered for 1–3 meter readability and crisp Vietnamese diacritics
Single warm Signal Orange accent for live temporal and telemetry anchors, paired with a full narrow-spectrum Night Red theme
Hardware-sympathetic motion limited to brief state transitions, once-per-second time updates, and a 10-minute ±1px LCD pixel shift

rules.name: The Single Signal Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm Signal Orange (`#E86C3A`) is reserved strictly for active temporal anchors and live telemetry—today's calendar badge, Sundays, lunar 1st/15th markers, hairline progress fills, active settings controls, focus rings, and inline actions. No secondary decorative accent competes with it; the only non-orange chromatic elements are the 7px wake-lock hardware status dots (`#46B87A` active, `#E5A440` standby).

rules.name: The Narrow-Spectrum Night Rule
rules.body: When Night Red mode is active (manually or automatically between 22:00 and 06:00), every canvas, panel, border, text ink, accent, and wake-lock dot collapses exclusively into narrow-spectrum crimson (`#FF2D2A`–`#E62E2D` on `#000000`–`#120505`) while maintaining WCAG AA contrast (≥ 4.5:1) and zero blue/green wavelength emission.

rules.name: The Tabular Lock Rule
rules.body: Every numeric figure across the clock, Vietnamese solar/lunar dates, monthly calendar cells, temperature, humidity, and dimmer readout enforces tabular numerals (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and `"tnum" 1`), with fixed `0.62em` hour/minute digit slots and `0.64em` second slots so ticking time never causes horizontal layout jitter.

rules.name: The Three-Meter Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Primary time (`clamp(4.2rem, 11.2vw, 9.2rem)` bold) and outdoor telemetry (`clamp(1.9rem, 4.6vw, 3.8rem)` bold) carry the visual weight for across-the-room reading, while dates, conditions, and compact utility controls stay quiet in medium-weight slate (`0.72rem`–`1.05rem`).

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Tonal Plane Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast drop shadows, ambient glows, or backdrop blur. Spatial depth is established strictly through three flat matte surface steps (`#050506` canvas, `#0E0F12` panel, `#16181E` elevated tile) separated by crisp `1px` hairline borders (`#1E2028` at rest, `#343846` active).

rules.name: The Event-Driven Motion Rule
rules.body: Never run continuous 60fps animations or decorative loops. Transitions are short, functional state responses (`150ms`–`300ms`), accompanied only by a once-per-second colon opacity pulse (`180ms`) and a `600ms` ±1px LCD pixel-shift once every 10 minutes.

dos: Do enforce `tabular-nums` (`"tnum" 1`) and fixed character slots on all live numerals so clock ticks and telemetry refreshes never shift neighboring text.
Do preserve the three-step flat matte hierarchy (`#050506` canvas, `#0E0F12` panel, `#16181E` elevated control) framed by `1px` hairlines (`#1E2028` / `#343846`).
Do route every color through CSS custom properties so Night Red mode (`body[data-night="true"]`) collapses the entire interface cleanly into narrow-spectrum crimson at ≥ 4.5:1 contrast.
Do use Signal Orange (`#E86C3A`) sparingly for temporal anchors, active selections, focus outlines, and linear telemetry fills.
Do keep motion strictly event-driven (`150ms`–`300ms` transitions, once-per-second colon/bar tick, 10-minute `600ms` ±1px pixel shift) to protect Apple A9 thermals and LCD longevity.
donts: Don't introduce drop shadows (`box-shadow`), glassmorphism (`backdrop-filter`), neon glows, gradients, or 3D bevels anywhere in the UI.
Don't add secondary decorative accent colors or allow white, green, blue, or amber elements to leak into Night Red mode.
Don't run continuous `requestAnimationFrame` loops or decorative idle animations that heat up the device during 24/7 plugged-in operation.
Don't replace self-hosted Be Vietnam Pro with a display face lacking crisp Vietnamese diacritics or tabular figure support.
Don't introduce modal overlays that obscure the primary clock when compact controls can swap cleanly inside the right column.
